title: 01. Foundations: UNSLOTH — 2-5x Faster Fine-Tuning
summary: Unsloth is a library that makes LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning 2-5x faster and uses 60% less memory through hand-crafted CUDA kernels, smart gradient checkpointing, and optimized attention implementations — with ZERO quality loss.

sections.title: What Is Unsloth?
sections.body: > **Unsloth is a library that makes LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning 2-5x faster and uses 60% less memory through hand-crafted CUDA kernels, smart gradient checkpointing, and optimized attention implementations — with ZERO quality loss.**

sections.title: How Unsloth Achieves Its Speed
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              UNSLOTH'S OPTIMIZATION TECHNIQUES                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  OPTIMIZATION 1: CUSTOM CUDA KERNELS
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Standard HuggingFace uses PyTorch operations:
  matmul → reshape → matmul → reshape → add → normalize...
  Each operation = separate GPU kernel launch = overhead!

  Unsloth writes FUSED CUDA kernels:
  Entire LoRA computation (A×B×input + scale) in ONE kernel
  No intermediate GPU memory allocation
  No multiple kernel launches

  SPEEDUP: 2-3x for the LoRA computation itself

  OPTIMIZATION 2: SMART GRADIENT CHECKPOINTING
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Normal training stores ALL activations for backward pass.
  Activations for 7B model, seq_len=2048: ~10 GB!

  Gradient checkpointing: recompute activations during backward.
  Saves memory but 30% slower (must compute twice).

  Unsloth's UNSLOTH_GRADIENT_CHECKPOINTING:
  - Stores activations for important layers (cheap to keep)
  - Recomputes only expensive layers
  - Net result: memory savings WITHOUT full speed penalty

  MEMORY SAVED: 30-40% vs standard training
  SPEED COST:   Only 5-10% (vs 30% for standard checkpointing)

  OPTIMIZATION 3: FLASH ATTENTION 2 INTEGRATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Standard attention: O(n²) memory in sequence length
  Flash Attention 2: O(n) memory, 2-4x faster

  Unsloth integrates FA2 seamlessly into QLoRA training.
  Enables training on LONGER sequences (4096, 8192 tokens)
  without running out of memory.

  OPTIMIZATION 4: OPTIMIZED ROPE + RMS NORM
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding): computed at every layer
  RMS Norm: computed at every layer

  HuggingFace: separate PyTorch ops for each
  Unsloth: fused CUDA kernels for both

  Speedup: additional 15-20% faster

  OPTIMIZATION 5: 4-bit QUANTIZATION IN TRAINING LOOP
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Smart dequantization only where needed.
  Keeps quantized longer during forward pass.
  Custom backward pass through quantized layers.

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  COMBINED RESULTS (vs standard HuggingFace + PEFT):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ┌────────────────────┬──────────────┬───────────────────────┐
  │  Metric            │  HF + PEFT   │  Unsloth              │
  ├────────────────────┼──────────────┼───────────────────────┤
  │  Tokens/second     │  ~800        │  ~3200  (4x faster!)  │
  │  GPU Memory (7B)   │  16 GB       │  6-8 GB (50% less!)   │
  │  Training time     │  4 hours     │  1 hour               │
  │  Model quality     │  baseline    │  identical ✅          │
  │  Max seq length    │  1024        │  4096+ (more RAM free) │
  └────────────────────┴──────────────┴───────────────────────┘

  Unsloth: same quality, 4x faster, 50% less memory. ✅
```
